IntervalQualityRepairDraft.Geometry.Projection {m : ℕ} (geometry : IntervalQualityRepairDraft.Geometry m) (n : ℕ)
  (q : ℝ → ℝ → Fin m → ℝ) (values : ℤ → Fin m → ℝ) : Prop

IntervalQualityRepairDraft.Method.advance {m : ℕ} (method : IntervalQualityRepairDraft.Method m) (n : ℕ) (dt : ℝ)
  (values : ℤ → Fin m → ℝ) : ℤ → Fin m → ℝ

IntervalQualityRepairDraft.SmoothCertificate {m : ℕ} (method : IntervalQualityRepairDraft.Method m)
  (q : ℝ → ℝ → Fin m → ℝ) (p : ℝ) : Type

IntervalQualityRepairDraft.SmoothCertificate.perturbed_at {m : ℕ} {method : IntervalQualityRepairDraft.Method m}
  {q : ℝ → ℝ → Fin m → ℝ} {p L : ℝ} (certificate : IntervalQualityRepairDraft.SmoothCertificate method q p)
  (stability : IntervalQualityRepairDraft.SameStepStability method L) (n : ℕ) (hn : certificate.threshold ≤ n) (dt : ℝ)
  (hdt : 0 < dt) (horizon : dt ≤ method.geometry.horizon) (projected values : ℤ → Fin m → ℝ)
  (hproj : method.geometry.Projection n q projected) (hp : method.admitted n dt projected)
  (hv : method.admitted n dt values) {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E)
  (herr :
    ∀ j ∈ Finset.Ico (method.geometry.inputStart n) (method.geometry.inputStart n + ↑(method.geometry.inputCount n)),
      ‖values j - projected j‖ ≤ E)
  (j : ℤ)
  (hj :
    j ∈ Finset.Ico (method.geometry.activeStart n) (method.geometry.activeStart n + ↑(method.geometry.activeCount n))) :
  ‖method.advance n dt values j - NumStability.finiteVolumeCellAverageOn (method.geometry.grid n) (fun x => q x dt) j‖ ≤
    (1 + L * dt) * E + certificate.constant * dt * method.geometry.mesh n ^ p

IntervalQualityRepairDraft.Method.two_state_step {m : ℕ} (method : IntervalQualityRepairDraft.Method m) (n : ℕ)
  (left right : Fin m → ℝ) (hl : left ∈ method.geometry.states) (hr : right ∈ method.geometry.states) (cut : ℤ) :
  ∃ dt, 0 < dt ∧ method.admitted n dt fun j => NumStability.riemannData left right right (↑j - ↑cut)

IntervalQualityRepairDraft.CFL1.advance_eq (n : ℕ) (values : ℤ → Fin 1 → ℝ) :
  IntervalQualityRepairDraft.CFL1.method.advance n (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.h n) values =
    (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.family 1).advance n values

IntervalQualityRepairDraft.CFL1.smooth_nonconstant_certificate :
  NumStability.CFLUnitShift.smoothProfile 0 ≠ NumStability.CFLUnitShift.smoothProfile 1 ∧
    ∃ p,
      1 < p ∧
        Nonempty
          (IntervalQualityRepairDraft.SmoothCertificate IntervalQualityRepairDraft.CFL1.method
            (fun x t => NumStability.CFLUnitShift.smoothProfile (x - t)) p)

IntervalQualityRepairDraft.CFL1.every_jump_available (n : ℕ) (left right : Fin 1 → ℝ) (cut : ℤ) :
  0 < NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.h n ∧
    IntervalQualityRepairDraft.CFL1.method.admitted n (NumStability.HighResolutionAdvectionLine.h n) fun j =>
      NumStability.riemannData left right right (↑j - ↑cut)

IntervalQualityRepairDraft.cinfty_definition {m : ℕ} (q : ℝ → ℝ → Fin m → ℝ) (flux : ℝ → (Fin m → ℝ) → Fin m → ℝ)
  (states : Set (Fin m → ℝ)) (a b T : ℝ) :
  NumStability.LocalConservationLaw.SpatialSmoothReferenceOn q flux states a b T ↔
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (Function.uncurry q) (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
      NumStability.LocalConservationLaw.SpatialRectangleReferenceOn q flux a b T ∧
        ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, q x t ∈ states
